tasks.short: Prepare comprehensive interpretive reports of findings.

steps.what: Prepare by opening the current study images
Read the comprehensive request and prior reports
State findings and the impression from the images
Draft interpretive reports text from the stated findings

loop.input: stated findings, impression, measurements, and the clinical question
loop.output: report sections for technique, findings, impression, and recommendation
loop.check: Each section uses only words and numbers she stated, and the impression sentence is the one she wrote. An added measurement or a changed laterality fails.
loop.stop: One draft. If she rejects it, she types the report and the file step does not release a model draft.
loop.why_not_simpler: A fixed sentence drops qualifiers she stated, such as laterality and comparison.

steps.what: Check drafted report text against the images and findings
File the accepted reports into the patient record

tasks.design: She states findings while the study is open in the imaging archive {OTHER}. A bounded loop drafts interpretive report sections only from those words, held until she checks them against the images. A gated write then files the accepted text into the patient record {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: The impression, laterality and measurements sat in prose she composed by hand, and a wrong sentence can harm a patient.
tasks.enabler_now: She can state those fields first. A bounded loop can draft sections only from them, and she still checks the meaning before the report is filed.
tasks.still_hard: Whether a report formatter counts as a medical device is undecided here. The image read itself stays hers.
tasks.human_edge: She is accountable for the impression, the laterality and the comparison with prior studies.
tasks.altitude: She still states every finding and checks every report. Only the assembly of sentences she already stated moves off her keyboard.

reach.task: Record acquisition parameters on the study
reach.learn: Which technique fields are already stored, so the report does not ask her to re-type them.

evidence.claim: Autoscriber records a consultation, and the clinician validates before the note is written back.

At Capio Ramsay Santé, self-estimated time per Tandem note fell from 6.69 to 4.72 minutes across care levels, median editing stayed 93 seconds, and three of seven authors are from the vendor. Those notes are not radiology reports.
The digest has no measured time for writing a radiology interpretive report, so this task's range is a scenario.
The Dutch IGJ says providers remain responsible for careful use of generative AI, including knowing whether it is a medical device.
Solely automated decisions with legal or similar significant effects need a GDPR article 22(2) basis. This design keeps her signature on the report.
Ambient recording that captures staff performance needs works-council consent under Dutch WOR article 27. This design has her type the findings and does not record speech.

assumptions: This task is the interpretive report. Reading the images is task 29-1224.00:17254. The procedure log is task 29-1224.00:17248. Sending the result is task 29-1224.00:17252. Those hours are not cut again here.

She types stated findings, impression and measurements. There is no ambient microphone, so works-council consent for staff recording is not in this build. Access to the imaging archive and a DPIA for health data still are.
Producer is the radiologist at s3. Fields are stated findings, impression, measurements and the clinical question. If she will not state them, she types the report and s6 does not file a model draft.
The draft is not the signed report. s6 only releases the text she accepted at s5. A later edit voids that release. The one percent is the release click, not a second typing.
Section names are fixed at build. She does not keep a mapping, so focal upkeep on this task is zero.
Her signature stays on the report, so the filing is not a solely automated care decision.
unknowns: Whether this hospital already stores the signed report in the same record as the text she checks.
Whether a report formatter is treated as a medical device under the rules that apply to this hospital.
research_questions: Is a formatter that drafts report sections from a radiologist's stated findings treated as a medical device here?

already_counted.description: Opening the study, reading the request and priors, stating the findings, and checking the draft against the images.

incremental.description: Section names are fixed at build. She does not keep a mapping or a phrase list. Upkeep hours are zero.

approvals.approved_version: The report text she accepted at s5, including findings, impression, laterality, measurements and comparison. A later edit voids the file.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If she rejects the draft and types the report, saving is 0. High is 12, under the net, when the impression is short and she still rewrites one section before the release click.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Perform or interpret diagnostic imaging outcomes across the named modalities.

steps.what: Read the request for diagnostic imaging procedures including the question
Find positron emission tomography and nuclear cardiology treadmill priors
Perform ultrasound when this radiologist is the operator
Interpret magnetic resonance imaging and computer tomography studies
State diagnostic outcomes including mammography calls she will stand behind

tasks.design: She still performs ultrasound she operates and interprets every study in the imaging archive {OTHER}. A configured open brings already-linked positron emission tomography and nuclear cardiology treadmill priors by patient identifier and study date. No model states a finding.
tasks.previous_blocker: Prior studies for those two examinations were opened by hand from the same archive, and the read itself is a certified judgement.
tasks.enabler_now: Where the archive already links studies by patient identifier and study date, that open can be configured. The read stays with her.
tasks.still_hard: A flag on a mammogram is not a read of magnetic resonance, computer tomography, ultrasound or a treadmill study. She still makes the call.
tasks.human_edge: She decides what the images show and which outcome she will stand behind.
tasks.altitude: Her week still is the image read and any ultrasound she performs. The only change is that linked priors open without a manual hunt.

reach.learn: Which studies she still operates herself, and which a sonographer already acquires.

evidence.claim: Transpara, from ScreenPoint Medical, flags breast cancer on mammograms.

The MASAI trial, in a vendor summary of the Lancet paper, reported 12 percent fewer interval cancers and sensitivity 80.5 percent against 73.8 percent at equal specificity. That is detection, not minutes saved.

The digest says image reading is a certified judgement beside a radiologist. It does not show a reader for magnetic resonance, computer tomography, positron emission tomography or ultrasound, so those reads stay hers.

assumptions: Technologist and sonographer acquisition is not this task's time, except ultrasound she performs herself. That hands-on share stays, and it is not cut.
The interpretive report is task 29-1224.00:17242. This task ends when she states the diagnostic outcome. It does not draft that report.

Producer of patient identifier and study date is the imaging request she reads at s1. Those fields are already on the request. If either is missing, she searches by hand and the configured open does not run.
No model calls a finding. A mammography flag, where one exists, is not priced as time saved on this task.
The open is existing archive configuration. She does not keep a hang-protocol list, so focal upkeep is zero.
There is no model call, so run cost is none. Access to the archive is still required.
unknowns: Which examinations this radiologist still performs herself.
Whether positron emission tomography and nuclear cardiology treadmill studies are already linked on the patient identifier and study date.
research_questions: For which modalities does this radiologist operate the scanner, rather than only interpret?

already_counted.description: Reading the request, performing ultrasound she operates, interpreting the studies, and stating the outcome.

incremental.description: The prior open uses identifiers already on the request. She does not maintain a protocol list. Upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If those priors are already open in the hanging she uses, saving is 0. High is 4 when she currently hunts them by hand and both identifiers are already on the request.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Document performance, interpretation, or outcomes of procedures performed.

steps.what: Read modality performance data for procedures just performed
Document the interpretation and clinical outcomes she owns
Copy accepted performance figures into the procedure record

tasks.design: She still writes the outcome line in the procedure record {DOCS}. After she accepts dose, series count, contrast volume and accession from the modality record {OTHER}, a gated copy writes only those figures into {DOCS}. Her prose is not rewritten.
tasks.previous_blocker: Those four figures often sit on the modality record, and she re-keys them into the procedure record by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: Once she marks which figures match the procedure she did, a deterministic copy can write that set into the second record.
tasks.still_hard: If both records are already the same store, there is nothing to copy. The outcome line stays her judgement.
tasks.human_edge: She decides which figures match the procedure and what clinical outcome to record.
tasks.altitude: She still documents the outcome. The re-key of four accepted figures is the only change, and only when the records are separate.

reach.task: Log dose and contrast on the modality record
reach.learn: Which of those fields are already stored before she accepts a copy.

evidence.claim: The digest does not measure a radiology procedure-log copy. This cut is only the re-key of figures she has already accepted.
Under the Dutch WGBO the treatment dossier is kept for twenty years after the last change.

assumptions: The comprehensive interpretive report is task 29-1224.00:17242. This task does not draft or rewrite that report. It records the outcome line and the procedure figures.
Producer is the radiologist at s2. Accepted fields are procedure code, contrast volume, dose, series count and accession. She accepts the set. She does not maintain the field list.
The copy runs only from {OTHER} into {DOCS}. If the customer already keeps those figures in one record, the copy does not run and the saving is zero.
No model writes the outcome line. There is no speech capture. Focal upkeep is zero because the field list is fixed at build.
The gate binds the accepted figures, not her prose. A later change to a figure voids the copy.
unknowns: Whether dose, contrast volume, series count and accession already sit in the procedure record.
Who enters those figures on the modality record today, the radiologist or the technologist.
research_questions: Are the modality record and the procedure record two stores for this hospital?

already_counted.description: Reading modality figures and writing the outcome line, including the check that the figures match the procedure.

incremental.description: The figure list is fixed at build. She does not keep it. Upkeep hours are zero.

approvals.approved_version: The figure set she accepted at s2: procedure code, contrast volume, dose, series count and accession. A later change to any figure voids the copy.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If dose and contrast already sit in the procedure record, saving is 0. High is 5 when she re-keys four accepted figures from the modality record into a second record.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Communicate examination results to physicians, patients, or families.

steps.what: Read the signed examination results and diagnostic information
Decide how to communicate results to referring physicians, patients, or families
Tell patients or families the examination result by phone
Tell a colleague physician a critical result by phone
Draft the written result for referring physicians from her points

loop.input: message points, paragraph id, recipient route, and the impression quote she marked
loop.check: The message cites only the paragraph she named and adds no finding that is absent from her message points.
loop.stop: One draft. If she rejects it, no send uses the draft.
loop.why_not_simpler: A fixed sentence cannot carry the impression she stated for this examination.

steps.what: Check the written message against the signed examination results
Send the accepted message to referring physicians or patients

tasks.design: She reads the signed report in {DOCS}, chooses the route, and still speaks critical results on {TELEPHONY}. A loop drafts a short message only from points she stated and a paragraph id she named. She checks it, then a gated send on {EMAIL} delivers that exact text.
tasks.previous_blocker: The written result was composed by hand from the signed report, and a sentence the report does not support can mislead a patient or a referrer.
tasks.enabler_now: She can mark message points and one published paragraph. A bounded loop can draft only from that set, and the send waits for her check.
tasks.still_hard: The phone call stays. Published guidance pages are not imaging result letters, so she still chooses every point.
tasks.human_edge: She decides who must hear the result by phone and which words leave the hospital.
tasks.altitude: She still places critical calls and signs every written result. The draft only fills a message from points she already chose.

reach.task: Read the imaging result and decide the next step
reach.learn: Which results they need as a signed message, and which need a call.

evidence.claim: Thuisarts publishes guideline-based texts for the public, with NHG, FMS and Patiëntenfederatie named as the makers.
Juvoly drafts referral letters and suggests ICPC, ICD-10 and SNOMED codes. That is letter drafting, not a send of imaging results.
The digest does not show those public texts as imaging result letters, and it gives no measured time for a radiology result message.
Patient chatbots must disclose that they are AI from 2 August 2026. This design sends a message she signs, not a chatbot.

assumptions: The signed interpretive report already exists from task 29-1224.00:17242. This task does not read the images again and does not rewrite that report.
Producer is the radiologist at s2. Fields are message points, paragraph id, recipient route and the impression quote she marked on the signed report. If she states no points, no draft is sent.
Phone calls are spoken. They are not a versioned send, so they carry no gate. The colleague call stays inside the hospital. The patient call and the written send go outside.
The paragraph id points at a public text already published. She selects it. She does not edit the library, and no extra role is added to maintain it. Focal upkeep is zero.
The send uses the message text she accepted at s6. A later edit voids the send. The message is not a chatbot, and her signature means it is not a solely automated decision.
Referring physicians outside this hospital, patients and families are external recipients.
unknowns: Which examination results this hospital requires in writing rather than by phone.
Whether the referring physician's address is already on the imaging request.
research_questions: Which results do referring family physicians need as a signed message, and which need a call first?

already_counted.description: Reading the signed report, choosing the route and the points, making both calls, and checking the written message.

incremental.description: She selects a published paragraph by id and does not keep the text. Upkeep hours are zero.

approvals.approved_version: The message text she accepted at s6, limited to her message points, paragraph id, recipient route and impression quote. A later edit voids the send.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Spoken calls stay. If she rejects the draft, saving is 0. High is 12 when a routine written result uses her points and one named paragraph and she changes nothing before the send.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: She still reads every study, states the finding, and places critical calls. A formatted report or a letter does not move the diagnosis to anyone else.
reach: Radiologic Technologists and Technicians: which modality fields are already stored before a copy runs.
Diagnostic Medical Sonographers: which examinations she still performs herself.
Family Medicine Physicians: which results they need in writing versus a call.
skills_to_grow: State findings, measurements and message points as fields before any draft.
Keep the image read, the procedure outcome and the critical call as her own work.
role.ambitious_version: No unattended agent reads a study, signs a report, copies a dose, or tells a patient a result.
